questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: The papers, the language and the travelling opportunities in the area

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: University of Otago is very well organised and a lovely place to study. The Uniflats are a great opportunity to make a lot of new friends.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Very easy. They are very informative

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *

questions.answer: I joined the kayaking club and it was absolutely amazing. And the southern youth choir. They have plenty of awesome socs and clubs at Otago.

questions.answer: Maori words are hard in the beginning

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Their openmindedness and cultural respect for nature and maori people.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Buy a car (or find someone who has one to go on trips)
Make some fun events with your neighbors
Join a club or two
